Hmmmm I see , so performance is calculated from the success rate mostly ?

Performance is calculated Daily according to how many bytes were served by the Pool in relation to all the other Pools as a percentage.  That percentage is then multiplied against the Total Reward Pool for the day to get the Pool's share. It's then split equally amongst the Nodes in each Pool, with Operator fees applied.  So, it is a GB/Node (bytes per node, more precisely) calc.  Look at your GB/Node from the Last Period on the Public Dashboard and compare them to other Pools to get a sense of how you are doing each day. ... In terms of  download speed, that helps the client experience but it doesn't give you more rewards.  There's a low threshold to meet to keep a client from rejecting your traffic.  If you dip below that threshold then you will lose traffic and that will impact rewards, but once you are above the threshold, speed doesn't impact rewards and you get to serve up what is allocated to you, regardless of the speed.  Hope this makes sense.  Can take another stab at it if it's not clear.  .... Traffic is allocated to you via a lottery system, weighted by the number of delegates in your Pool. (edited)
